items.title_orig: One of the Most Overlooked Album of the 90's was Released Today - Harvest Moon - Neil Young - 1993
items.article_text:
With backing vocals from Linda Ronstadt and James Taylor
 Edit: I was 15 when this came out, so from my perspective, it was overlooked, certainly in my age group. I had a friend whose uncle gave us bootleg Crazy Horse cassettes, that's the only reason I had even heard of him. Here are a few albums that dominated my social sphere in 93:
 • Nirvana – In Utero
 • The Smashing Pumpkins – Siamese Dream
 • Pearl Jam – Vs.
 • Radiohead – Pablo Honey
 • Tool – Undertow
 • The Cranberries – Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?
 • Snoop Dogg – Doggystyle
 • Wu-Tang Clan – Enter the Wu-Tang
